Grace — we can deliver everything requested with the following caveats and controls:

1) Authn log slice (2027-05-01 -> 2027-06-30):
   - Default slice will include: timestamp, event_type (login/sso_failure/token_refresh), user_id_hash, client_app, source_ip (first 3 octets), device_type, region, and session_duration_ms.

   - We'll provide attestation records (who attested, timestamp, scope) and a redacted list of privileged IDs. If the auditor needs the mapping to actual usernames we require a data-use agreement and secure handoff.

5) Timeline and delivery method:
   - Bridge letter + SOC2 summary: within 3 business days.
   - Extracts and attestation exports: within 7 business days after scope confirmation.
   - Delivery via secure S3 presigned link or encrypted Drive folder.

Runbook & internal link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/soc2-evidence-extract (access controlled).
